scope: All units read: text for sense, translation and word glosses against the text. The text was not compared with the source page.

items.issue: raṅgayātrā is the journey to Śrīraṅgam (so the word gloss); the translation had “temple-procession”.
items.change: Now “the journey to Śrīraṅgam is proclaimed”.

items.issue: advandvahetoḥ (“not for freedom from the pairs of opposites”), gurum and hare were left out.
śramamuṣi (“that takes away weariness”) was left out.
yāmīś ciraṃ yātanāḥ is “the long torments of Yama”, object of “brooding”; it had been turned into a quoted thought.
items.change: Now “brooding in many ways on Yama's long torments”.

items.issue: kāntāmaṇi describes Rukmiṇī (“gem among women”), not Kṛṣṇa as “the lover-gem”; ghana-kuca-dvandva was reduced to “breast”.
items.change: Retranslated as in the word gloss.

items.issue: pariṇāmapeśalam was “tender to decay”, against the gloss “fair only until it changes”.
māyā jagad avikalaṃ tāvakī is “the whole world is your māyā”.
The two friends were rendered “as choice lotus-arrows”; the tradition (and the word gloss) takes Padma and Śara as their names.
items.change: Now “the excellent brāhmaṇas Padma and Śara”.
